newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta eases slightly amid intervention fears.
newsitem.headline: Peseta eases slightly amid intervention fears.

text.p: The peseta eased slightly from its stronger opening level amid dealer talk that the Bank of Spain was selling pesetas versus the mark at around 84.15 pesetas.
Of six traders asked, three said the Bank of Spain was likely to have bought marks at around 84.15 pesetas while the other three said that could have be the result of a market correction.
True to policy, the Bank of Spain declined to comment.
At 0845 GMT the peseta was trading 84.17/19 after it hit 84.13/15. It ended on Wednesday at 84.12/15 from an opening level at 84.27/28.
